title: 1.2.8 May 12, 1842
book: The First Fifty Years of Relief Society
notes: 119 primary documents; Church Historians Press; EN-only

footnotes.text: Joseph Smith’s journal indicates that he attended a Relief Society meeting on May 12, 1842. (Joseph Smith, Journal, May 12, 1842, inJSP,J2:55–56.)

Masons who did not keep moral obligations could be censured by their lodge. For instance, John C. Bennett was disciplined for sexual immorality by both the Pickaway, Illinois, lodge and the Nauvoo lodge. (JSP,J2:65n255, 67n268.)
